title: Sailing
description: Sailing in the beautiful waters of the Helsinki archipelago. A popular activity for all levels of sailors.

title: Painting
description: Explore your creativity at painting workshops in Kallio, Helsinki. A vibrant area for artists and hobbyists alike.

title: Basketball
description: Join a game of basketball at Pasilan sports hall. A great place for both casual and competitive players.

title: Guitar
description: Learn to play the guitar in one of Helsinki's many music schools located in Kamppi, the heart of the city.
